contrasts.note: contract §5.0 row 2 (split lower); seat b3 = mid laner, own side

rules.verdict: per option and side, same-seed pairs vs the control on the same side; precedence unmeasurable > reversed > guard_failed > confirmed (every claim OK on both sides) > one_sided > insufficient. fallbackMetric only if the registered metric has < 200 valid pairs on a side.
rules.groups: claims carry a group; each group gets its own verdict (same rules). The option's verdict still needs every claim, so a win condition is confirmed only if every group is confirmed. objectiveControl: presence (arrived within 9 units, contestShare) and capture (our side took it, captureShare) are judged separately; presence without capture is reported as 'presence only' and is NOT confirmed (Owner: no confirmed without control effect).
rules.distinctness: contrast b-arm minus a-arm on the same side and seed: distinct = direction matches, z >= 3 and |rel| >= 5 % on BOTH sides; reversed if either side z <= -3 in the opposite direction; unmeasurable if < 200 pairs; else not_distinct. One metric per pair (contract §5.0 multiple-comparison rule; 3 tests per side).
rules.interaction: per seed (combo - ctrl) - (partA - ctrl) - (partB - ctrl); flagged if, on EITHER side, z >= 3 and the mean is >= 5 % of the control mean in the registered direction (up = surge beyond the sum of the parts). Unmeasurable if < 200 pairs.
rules.conflict: combo vs the part on the same side; flagged if, on EITHER side, the part's own claim metric is lower in the combo with z <= -3 and |rel| >= 5 % (the other choice cancels it).

promotionRule.winCondition: A win condition may be promoted to live (v21 director rulesets only) only if: its verdict is confirmed; each contrast with another promoted direction is distinct (a not_distinct/reversed pair means the two may not both go live -> D-17, Owner decides, both stay design until then); any SIDE_ASYMMETRY flag on it is investigated and documented. teamfightScaling is not measured and stays design.
promotionRule.combination: If any interaction or conflict is flagged or unmeasurable, the strong-side x aggressive combination is reported to the Owner as a finding; no coefficient, cap or engine change is made in this round (Owner: no hidden bonus, no rule change without Owner). Strong side and aggressive stance stay live as approved.
promotionRule.notMeasuredHere: win rate, economy (gold lead), match length and side bias are REPORTED ONLY (win, goldLeadAt.early/mid, durationMin). Owner: they must be validated before any formal release; nothing here claims a direction is favourable.

sideAsymmetry.note: flag only; flagged options are not promoted until investigated and documented (same rule as C5R)
